name: ascii-portrait
title: ASCII portrait
description: A face redrawn in fine Braille glyphs, graded for skin and shadow, with contour strokes, a develop reveal and a before/after split with the photo.

name: ascii-canvas
title: ASCII canvas
description: A glyph pad you paint with the pointer: ink spreads, curls and fades into glowing trails, and clicks send ripples that bend them.

name: ascii-reveal
title: ASCII reveal
description: An image that resolves out of glyphs: cells lock in and hand over to the real photo along a sweep, on view, on hover or on cue.
